name: Who-What-When Matrix
deliverable: Linear operational assignment of accountable owners and hard deadlines

steps.text: Open with the three rules: each task is an observable artifact, each owner is one named person, each date is a calendar date.
Work through the priority decisions one row at a time, asking for the single owner first, then the exact due date and how it will be proved.
Read the finished matrix aloud and confirm each owner has the authority and time to meet the date before anyone leaves.

failure: Shared ownership: a row is assigned to a team or two names, so no one feels the commitment when the date arrives.
intervention: Stop at the row and ask which one person is the driver; list the other as a contributor, then replace any soft date with a calendar date.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A matrix format widely used in project management; no single documented originator.
